dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Adds many specific AWS nuances (e.g., subscription‑filter 2x concurrency budget, data‑protection redaction, silent retention deletions, cross‑account resource‑policy gating) that a generic model may not enumerate, but the core concepts (IAM, sequence token, log group naming) are already well‑known, so it falls short of a perfect 20.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Provides an AWS‑specific step order and concrete CLI commands for each diagnostic layer, but some procedures are generic (e.g., "run describe‑log-groups" without explicit region handling or pagination) and the branching criteria in the decision tree are not always spelled out with precise thresholds.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: The NEVER list is concrete and explains why each pitfall is bad, yet it omits several common anti‑patterns such as KMS key permission mismatches, subtle resource‑policy conflicts, and misuse of CloudWatch Logs Insights when diagnosing ingestion, reducing completeness.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Frontmatter, activation triggers, invocation schema, and example are complete, but the description lacks a separate concise "WHEN to invoke" bullet distinct from the longer narrative, and there is no explicit versioning compatibility note for future schema changes.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: Quick‑start section gives a high‑level map, but the bulk of the document is dense; critical safety rules (confirmation gate) are buried deep, which can overload the reader before they reach the most important constraints.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Excellent calibration: all state‑changing CLI commands are gated behind explicit CONFIRM prompts, and read‑only probes are used first, matching the fragility of CloudWatch Logs operations.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a recognizable structure (quick start, mindset, philosophy, stepwise process, anti‑patterns, safety checks, remediation), but mixes tables and narrative inconsistently and deviates from a strict heading hierarchy, preventing a perfectly uniform pattern.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides a usable decision tree, concrete CLI commands, and output format examples, yet it lacks handling for pagination, explicit region selection, and robust error handling for CLI failures; also no fallback when simulate‑principal‑policy is unavailable.
